name: Central Phuket / bypass retail core
capture_notes: Strongest modern retail node on the island around Central Festival, Central Floresta, Big C, hospitals, and high-throughput bypass frontage. Best fit for destination-fast or hybrid retail charging with visible bays.

name: Patong - Kathu resort and connector core
capture_notes: Dense resort, tourism, nightlife, and mid-island pass-through demand spanning Patong and the Kathu connector. Demand is strong but competition is already meaningful.

name: Phuket Old Town / Ratsada civic-commercial core
capture_notes: Old-town retail, government, hospital, and transport demand cluster with good urban repeat behavior but tighter parking than mall environments.

name: Choeng Thale - Bang Tao - Laguna lifestyle belt
capture_notes: Affluent west-coast lifestyle and resort zone anchored by Porto, Boat Avenue, Laguna hotels, and premium residential traffic.

name: Airport - Mai Khao north gateway
capture_notes: Airport, resort, and long-distance arrival demand concentrated on the north gateway with strong transfer and rental-car relevance.

name: Chalong - Rawai south urban-tourism band
capture_notes: South-island demand cluster around Chalong retail, pier activity, local residential density, and Rawai tourism/dining trips.

name: Kamala - Surin west-coast resort belt
capture_notes: Resort-led west-coast demand with good destination charging behavior but more distributed site geography than Patong or Thalang.
